global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth cradling tender chashu pork and noodles, topped with finely chopped green onions. It sits in a patterned bowl against a dark surface, illuminated to highlight the glossy broth and vibrant garnish.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: The bowl is white ceramic with a colorful geometric pattern and a smooth, slightly glossy rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is deep amber, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and meat with scattered green onions and sesame seeds.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show glistening, tender texture with caramelized edges and visible fat marbling, garnished with green onions.
